schema_and_pipeline.summary: v2 pending is ready, source locale is en, both staged sources are present, and controlled classification is complete.

factual_methodology.summary: Central fiscal, macroeconomic, reconstruction, displacement, institutional and officeholder claims were checked against cited primary/official sources; stock/flow and capacity/output caveats are explicit.

taxonomy.summary: Strategic Transitions uses all three required dimensions; geography, topics and phenomena are controlled values.

translation_semantic_parity.summary: EN and PT-BR preserve thesis, numerical claims, epistemic qualifications and visual content; the previously rejected localization defects are corrected.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Direct thesis-led opening; mechanism-specific analytical headings; natural PT-BR localization; no public checklist/template or QA-process scars; coherent progression and controlled repetition.

contextual_depth.summary: War-state capacity, fiscal dependence, EU accession, reconstruction, labour/demography and displacement are connected through explicit mechanisms.

visual_evidence_readiness.signature: 2 charts + 1 causal flow + 1 mind map + structured evidence tables in both locales
visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Visuals clarify fiscal composition, reconstruction burden and transmission; units/categories are explicit and bilingual semantics align.
visual_evidence_readiness.limitations: No map is required for the dossier's principal national fiscal-institutional-demographic mechanism.

country_context_contract.summary: Country geography is explicit; four materially related canonical research IDs are declared; the dossier is durable causal context rather than an encyclopedic profile.

conflict_security_social_change.summary: Administrative facts, reported capacity, observed damage, displacement indicators, forecasts and scenarios are distinguished and limitations are stated.

contrary_evidence: Ukraine's massive physical damage, demographic displacement and dependence on official finance argue against treating wartime institutional continuity as evidence of normal economic conditions.
Functioning banks, continued exports, domestic defence production, digital administration and progress toward EU accession argue against a state-collapse narrative.

Large reconstruction needs create investment opportunity but do not guarantee growth because security risk, governance, labour supply, insurance and project execution determine whether capital becomes productive capacity.
limitations: Population, labour-force and migration denominators are unusually uncertain under occupation, displacement and wartime administrative conditions.
The 2026 state budget was materially amended during the year; original and amended defence and deficit figures describe different fiscal envelopes.
RDNA5 damage and reconstruction estimates have a 31 December 2025 cutoff and therefore exclude subsequent destruction.
Defence-industry capacity and procurement shares are official operational figures rather than independently audited national accounts.
IMF and NBU forecasts remain highly conditional on security assumptions and external-financing continuity.
notes: Revision 1 corrects the PT-BR localization defects that caused the prior QA rejection. Pre-decision canonical-state recheck found no public bundle for this ID; this is a new publication candidate.

en.title: Ukraine: war-state capacity, demographic rupture and the economics of reconstruction
en.deck: Ukraine has preserved macroeconomic and institutional continuity under war, but its long-run trajectory depends on converting external finance, EU accession, reconstruction and defence innovation into productive capacity while reversing demographic loss.

pt-BR.title: Ucrânia: capacidade estatal de guerra, ruptura demográfica e economia da reconstrução
pt-BR.deck: A Ucrânia preservou continuidade macroeconômica e institucional durante a guerra, mas sua trajetória depende de converter financiamento externo, adesão à UE, reconstrução e inovação de defesa em capacidade produtiva enquanto enfrenta perda demográfica.
